verified_facts.text: The hotel overlooks the bay of Cala di Volpe, whose name means 'the cove of the fox'.
verified_facts.excerpt: overlooking one of the island’s most picturesque bays—named Cala di Volpe, or “the cove of the fox,”

verified_facts.text: The hotel was conceived and designed by Jacques Couelle, who called himself a 'sculptor of houses' rather than an architect.
verified_facts.excerpt: Conceived and designed by Jacques Couëlle, who preferred to call himself a “sculptor of houses” rather than an architect.

verified_facts.text: The hotel stretches out over the bay like a village.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stretching out over the bay like a timeless village and seemingly sculpted by the wind

verified_facts.text: Couelle used the whitewashed Mediterranean style with curves, arches, spirals, picture windows and stained glass.
verified_facts.excerpt: used the whitewashed Mediterranean style and bent it to his will, with curves, arches, spirals, picture windows, and stained glass.

verified_facts.text: The hotel appeared in the James Bond film The Spy Who Loved Me.
verified_facts.excerpt: grab the attention of the James Bond location scouts, and played a starring role in

verified_facts.text: Rooms have whitewashed walls with trompe-l'oeil paintings, each one unique.
verified_facts.excerpt: trompe-l’œil paintings, each one unique

verified_facts.text: Rooms have handcrafted furniture painted to match each room's theme and ceramic tilework on the floors and in the bathrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: handcrafted furniture, painted to match each room’s theme, is complemented by vibrant ceramic tilework throughout the floors and bathrooms.

verified_facts.text: Furniture such as bedside tables, shelves and sofas is built into the whitewashed walls, under asymmetrical bamboo ceilings.
verified_facts.excerpt: The furniture—bedside tables, the shelves, even the sofa—is built into the rough whitewashed walls, with asymmetrical bamboo ceilings forming a calming canopy.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have a private terrace with views of land and sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Linger on your private terrace in a plush bathrobe and slippers, soaking in the breathtaking panorama of land and sea

verified_facts.text: The Harrods Suite has three king bedrooms, a bay view and a rooftop plunge pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Suite, 3 King, Bay view, Roof Top, Plunge pool

verified_facts.text: The Harrods Suite includes a bar, a wine cellar and a private infinity pool on a panoramic roof terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: three king bedrooms, a bar, a wine cellar, and a private infinity pool on a panoramic roof terrace

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an Olympic-size saltwater pool by the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Olympic-size Saltwater Pool

verified_facts.text: The SHISEIDO Spa draws on Japanese savoir-faire and omotenashi, hospitality from the heart.
verified_facts.excerpt: discover Japanese savoir-faire, founded on 150 years of expertise and omotenashi—a concept best translated as hospitality from the heart

verified_facts.text: The spa's Thermal Baths ritual includes a steam room, sauna, emotional shower and natural Sardinian scrubs.
verified_facts.excerpt: This intimate ritual includes a steam room, sauna, emotional shower, and genuinely lovely natural Sardinian scrubs

verified_facts.text: The hotel's private beach, reserved for hotel guests, is a five-minute boat ride from the hotel's private marina.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just a five-minute scenic boat ride from the hotel’s private marina lies our exclusive beach, renowned for its legendary white sands and crystal-clear waters. Reserved exclusively for hotel guests.

verified_facts.text: Calm waters allow paddleboarding and kayaking, as well as scuba diving and windsurfing.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our calm seabed offers ideal conditions for paddleboarding and kayaking, while the more adventurous can enjoy scuba diving and windsurfing.

verified_facts.text: The Mouratoglou Tennis Center Sardinia has tennis and padel courts with private lessons, group sessions and kids' programs.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Mouratoglou Tennis Center Sardinia delivers a world-class tennis and padel experience for players of all ages. The center offers a variety of tailor-made programs, including private lessons, group sessions, kids’ programs

verified_facts.text: The resort's 18-hole golf course is a short drive away.
verified_facts.excerpt: a short drive away, you will find the resort’s 18-hole golf course and academy

verified_facts.text: La Volpe Kids Club welcomes children aged 3 to 12, with an outdoor playground, gardening and children's cooking classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Toy Club features a multilingual staff, outdoor playground, and hands-on activities, including gardening and exclusive children’s cooking classes.

verified_facts.text: The kids club is open daily during the hotel's season.
verified_facts.excerpt: Open daily during the hotel’s season from 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM.

verified_facts.text: Guests have access to a garden and a petting zoo.
verified_facts.excerpt: a garden accessible to guests and a petting zoo

verified_facts.text: Matsuhisa at Cala di Volpe serves Nobu-style Japanese cuisine by Chef Nobuyuki Matsuhisa.
verified_facts.excerpt: The art of Japanese cuisine, Nobu-style, by Chef Nobuyuki Matsuhisa

verified_facts.text: The Atrium Bar has bay views, live piano music and a signature Bellini.
verified_facts.excerpt: combines stunning bay views, striking architecture, live piano music, and a menu of irresistible cocktails, including the signature Bellini

verified_facts.text: A smart casual dress code applies at dinner in all restaurants and bars; shorts and beachwear are not permitted.
verified_facts.excerpt: a smart casual dress code is in effect; shorts and beachwear are not permitted

verified_facts.text: To explore the island further, guests would need a rental car.
verified_facts.excerpt: To explore the island further, you would need a rental

verified_facts.text: The closest airport is Olbia Costa Smeralda Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: The closest airport near Hotel Cala di Volpe, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Costa Smeralda is Olbia Costa Smeralda Airport (OLB).
